title: CIA report, Hungary 1956: sketch of flying object formation and course, Budapest-Moscow
description: CIA Information Report on Hungary, "Report of Unusual Flying Object Sightings and Attendant Scientific Activity" (distributed 17 Apr 56, information dated Nov 55), with an inline sketch. The sketch shows about ten small circles in diagonal rows, with a line running from "Budapest" at upper left to "Moscow" at lower right. The text says it came with a letter from the source's niece in Budapest "indicating the formation and suspected course of the above objects" and quotes the letter on "flying saucers (rockets)" said to travel 12 thousand km per hour.
